dateline: Las Vegas, NV — BTS closes out ARIRANG World Tour's 4-night Las Vegas residency; Night 4 at Allegiant Stadium completes ~260,000-fan run (May 23–28)
heroHeadline: Day 4,732: BTS Closes Out Las Vegas ARIRANG World Tour Residency — Night 4 Completes Four-Night, ~260,000-Fan Run at Allegiant Stadium
heroSubtitle: May 28, 2026 is Day 4,732 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. Tonight is the fourth and final night of BTS's sold-out ARIRANG World Tour Las Vegas residency at Allegiant Stadium (65,000 capacity), completing a ~260,000-fan four-night run (May 23, 24, 27–28) that became the fastest sellout in Allegiant Stadium history (23 minutes). Billed as the largest stadium tour in K-pop history — 85+ dates across 34 cities in 23 countries — the ARIRANG World Tour is BTS's first full-group stadium run since completing South Korea's mandatory military service. After Las Vegas, the tour moves to Busan, South Korea for anniversary-period shows on June 12–13, then to Europe in July (Brussels, London, Munich, Paris). The BTS × Oreo limited-edition hotteok-flavored collaboration goes on sale June 1 in 80+ countries. On May 26, 'SWIM' surpassed 500 million Spotify streams (first 2026 release globally to reach that milestone); BTS swept three awards at the 52nd AMAs on May 25 (Artist of the Year, Song of Summer, Best Male K-Pop Artist), bringing total AMA wins to 14 — the most of any act in AMA history.
